children: Microsoft (MSFT, Financials), was among the biggest positions traded in President Donald Trump's July financial disclosure, which showed 1,156 securities transactions worth roughly $79 million to $270 million in total.

The filing showed sales of Microsoft and Amazon , each valued between $5 million and $25 million, on July 20. Three days later, the portfolio bought $100,001 to $250,000 of Microsoft and $1,001 to $15,000 of Amazon.

Other July activity included a $1 million to $5 million Oracle sale and a $500,001 to $1 million Nvidia purchase. The portfolio also bought $1 million to $5 million each of Intuit , Marvell Technology, Salesforce and Church & Dwight.

The disclosure also showed transactions involving Tesla (TSLA, Financials) and SpaceX (SPCX, Financials), along with several bond and sector ETFs. The filing followed 1,051 transactions reported for June.
Because the disclosure reports transaction ranges rather than exact amounts, it does not show the precise size or overall change in each position.
The next catalyst is the next periodic transaction disclosure, which could provide another snapshot of changes in the portfolio.

title: Trump's Latest Stock Disclosure Reveals a Surprising Trading Pattern
